key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Episodic, often asymptomatic discovered incidentally. LOCATION: Left chest or precordial. DURATION: Brief episodes of palpitations or atypical chest pain. CHARACTER: Sharp, brief, atypical chest pain NOT typical angina. Palpitations. AGGRAVATING: Anxiety, caffeine, dehydration. RELIEVING: Rest, beta-blockers. TIMING: Episodic, unpredictable. SEVERITY: Mild, 2-4/10. KEY POSITIVES: Young female (classic), mid-systolic click on exam, late systolic murmur, palpitations, atypical chest pain, anxiety, thin body habitus. KEY NEGATIVES: NOT exertional angina, NOT dyspnea typically (unless severe regurgitation).

red_flags: Family history of sudden cardiac death
